title: Pasting two forward left-coefficient tensor actions
statement:
Use monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with associator $\alpha:(U\otimes V)\otimes W\to U\otimes(V\otimes W)$ and left unitor $\lambda$. A strong monoidal functor has the structure of [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]; write $\delta^H_{U,V}:H(U\otimes V)\xrightarrow{\sim}HU\otimes HV$ and $e_H:H\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1$ for its inverse structure maps. Set $h^H_N=\lambda_N\circ(e_H\otimes1_N)$ and $a^H_{B,B',N}=\alpha_{HB,HB',N}\circ(\delta^H_{B,B'}\otimes1_N)$. Composition is right to left.
Let $\mathcal C_0,\mathcal C_1,\mathcal C_2$ be monoidal categories. Let $F:\mathcal C_0\to\mathcal C_1$ and $Q:\mathcal C_1\to\mathcal C_2$ be strong monoidal, and let $R:\mathcal C_1\to\mathcal C_0$, $J:\mathcal C_2\to\mathcal C_1$ be arbitrary functors. Set $S=QF$, $P=RJ$, with the composite inverse comparisons
$$\delta^S_{B,B'}=\delta^Q_{FB,FB'}\circ Q(\delta^F_{B,B'}),\qquad e_S=e_Q\circ Q(e_F).$$
Suppose given natural transformations
$$t_{B,N}:B\otimes RN\to R(FB\otimes N),\qquad v_{C,M}:C\otimes JM\to J(QC\otimes M)$$
for $B\in\mathcal C_0$, $N,C\in\mathcal C_1$, $M\in\mathcal C_2$. Require that for each pair $(H,K,w)=(F,R,t)$ and $(Q,J,v)$, and all appropriately typed $D,D',L$, the following two equations hold:
$$K(h^H_L)\circ w_{\mathbf1,L}=\lambda_{KL},$$
$$K(a^H_{D,D',L})\circ w_{D\otimes D',L}=w_{D,HD'\otimes L}\circ(1_D\otimes w_{D',L})\circ\alpha_{D,D',KL}.$$
Define the specified composite
$$T_{B,M}=R(v_{FB,M})\circ t_{B,JM}:B\otimes PM\longrightarrow P(SB\otimes M).$$
Then $T$ is natural in both variables and satisfies
$$P(h^S_M)\circ T_{\mathbf1,M}=\lambda_{PM},$$
$$P(a^S_{B,B',M})\circ T_{B\otimes B',M}=T_{B,SB'\otimes M}\circ(1_B\otimes T_{B',M})\circ\alpha_{B,B',PM}.$$
No adjunction, symmetry, invertibility of $t,v,T$, or geometric composition law is assumed.
